title: Backend System Design Overview
summary: The top backend layer: a Supabase Edge Function validates API actions, manages project resources, creates durable worker jobs, serves status reads, and handles the direct mesh-generation path.

nodes.label: API Clients
nodes.description: CLI and other HTTP callers that submit action-based JSON requests and consume immediate responses.

details.responsibility: Choose an API action, supply its JSON fields, and retain returned project, part, or job identifiers.

inputs.name: HTTP response
inputs.description: Immediate result, durable job reference, current job state, or error.

outputs.name: POST request
outputs.description: A JSON object with one of the cad-agent action names.

nodes.label: cad-agent
nodes.description: The current Supabase Edge Function and top-level backend API for project, part, job, status, deletion, and chat actions.

details.responsibility: Validate one action-based POST request, run its request-scoped orchestration, and return a JSON response.
trigger: An HTTP POST request reaches the cad-agent function.
preconditions: SUPABASE_URL and SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY must be configured.
OPENAI_API_KEY is required only for direct mesh chat generation.
Gateway JWT verification is currently disabled for this function.

inputs.name: action request
inputs.description: One of 15 supported actions plus action-specific names, UUIDs, messages, or request text.

outputs.name: JSON response
outputs.description: Synchronous resource data, a queued job ID, status details, or a typed HTTP error.

decisionPoints: Project and part actions perform direct catalog CRUD and storage lifecycle work.
CAD part creation initializes blank source and also queues build_index; explicit index, validation, export, and CAD chat actions create durable database jobs and return immediately.
Mesh chat is the only path that calls OpenAI and replaces model.py directly in this function.
details.shortCircuit: Non-POST requests return 405; invalid bodies, actions, names, UUIDs, or unsupported part operations return request errors before the handler completes.

operations.concurrency: The Edge Runtime may execute independent requests concurrently; the function keeps no process-local workflow state.
operations.retry: No request-level retry is implemented. Active build-index insertion can resolve and return an existing queued/running job after a uniqueness conflict.
observability: HTTP status and JSON error message
durable job state read through status actions

nodes.label: Project Catalog
nodes.description: Postgres projects and parts tables holding project identity, part identity, names, and CAD/mesh type.

details.responsibility: Durably own projects and their CAD or mesh part records.
durableReads: project and part lookup by ID or name
part type used to select validation/export/chat behavior

nodes.label: Workflow Job Tables
nodes.description: Postgres index_jobs, generation_jobs, and edit_jobs rows used for asynchronous index, validation, export, retrieval-test, and CAD-edit work.

details.responsibility: Durably own queued work and expose job status/results without the Edge Function calling workers directly.

inputs.name: edit work
inputs.description: An initial_design request bound to a linked blank CAD part; an established linked request with requested_part_id; or an unlinked project-resolved request with up to eight normalized messages.

outputs.name: status record
outputs.description: Selected index or edit job fields safe for the API response.

durableWrites: automatic build_index row during CAD part creation
downstream: Independent workers claim these rows outside the Edge Function layer.

nodes.label: 3dProjects Storage
nodes.description: Private object storage for part source, generated exports, edit candidates, and project index artifacts.

details.responsibility: Durably own project files manipulated or inspected by top-layer API actions.
durableReads: CAD model.py for source SHA-256 and exact blank-part detection
mesh model.py for direct chat generation
durableWrites: blank CAD model.py containing only the system runtime import and params.json during CAD part creation
mesh starter source and params.json during mesh part creation
recursive project/part source, export, and candidate deletion

failureConditions.outcome: The function attempts to remove the source prefix and delete the new parts row.
Database and storage changes are not covered by one transaction.

nodes.label: OpenAI Responses API
nodes.description: External structured-output dependency used only when chat targets a linked mesh part.

details.responsibility: Return a strict generated_code string containing the complete replacement mesh model body.

inputs.name: mesh conversation
inputs.description: At most eight normalized messages plus the current mesh model.py source.

outputs.name: model_agent_response
outputs.description: Strict JSON schema with one non-empty generated_code field.

details.shortCircuit: Empty output, invalid JSON, missing code, or a status-only value fails the HTTP request before storage replacement.

operations.retry: No Edge Function retry is implemented.

response.label: immediate result or durable job reference

details.summary: Every public operation enters through the single action router and completes within one HTTP request.
preconditions: Request method is POST and the body is a JSON object with a supported action.
details.failureBehavior: RequestError responses preserve their 400, 404, or 409 status; other errors return 500 with a JSON error field.
details.trustBoundary: Supabase gateway JWT verification is disabled in config; the function itself creates a service-role Supabase client for every accepted request.

details.summary: The Edge Function initiates every catalog read and write.
details.failureBehavior: Duplicate names return 409 and missing resources return 404; backend query errors become HTTP 500.

edges.label: queue, inspect, or cancel durable work

request.label: job insert, status select, or queued cancellation

response.label: job ID, current state, or acknowledgement

details.summary: The Edge Function creates durable handoffs and reads their state; it does not synchronously invoke a worker.
details.durability: Accepted index, validation, export, Getter-test, and CAD-edit actions remain represented by database rows after the HTTP response.
details.failureBehavior: Most failed inserts or lookups fail the request. If only automatic indexing fails after CAD creation, the part remains and the response reports index_status=not_queued with a manual /index warning. Deletion preparation cancels queued rows but blocks while applicable work is running.

edges.label: initialize, read, replace, or delete project files

request.label: object upload, download, list, or remove

response.label: stored object data or operation result

details.summary: The Edge Function initiates every storage operation; storage never initiates a request.
details.operation: Create blank CAD or mesh starter files, detect an exact blank CAD source for initial design, hash accepted CAD source, read/replace mesh source, and recursively remove project or part prefixes.
details.durability: Mesh chat replaces model.py before its export job insert. Those two effects are not atomic.
details.failureBehavior: A storage error fails the request. Part creation attempts compensating storage and database cleanup.

details.summary: Only linked mesh chat takes this direct synchronous AI path. CAD chat queues edit_jobs instead.
details.trustBoundary: Current mesh model.py and recent conversation cross to the external API.
details.failureBehavior: Any API or response-contract failure returns HTTP 500 and leaves model.py unchanged.
